Cluster l-cluster

StableLayout · since 0.1.0

Horizontal group that wraps, with a gap and vertically centered items: button groups, badge lists, tags.

  1. 1: Pick this part1Pick this part
  2. 2: Build it2Build it
  3. 3: Check your build3Check your build
  4. 4: Spec sheet4Spec sheet

1

Pick this part

Pick l-cluster for

  • Button groups, badge lists, tags and metadata rows that should wrap on narrow screens.

Pick another part for

  • Two columns of page content: use l-sidebar or l-grid.
  • Items that must stay equal width: use l-switcher.

2

Build it

  1. Start with an element and add class="l-cluster".
  2. Put the parts inside. The layout sets the space between them, so they need no margins.
Show markup 5 lines 
<div class="l-cluster">
  <span class="c-badge">Design</span>
  <span class="c-badge">Research</span>
  <span class="c-badge">Accessibility</span>
</div>

3

Check your build

Each piece that doesn't fit was run through mcss-lite validate when this page was built. The output below is real.

Fits

Let items wrap; the gap holds on every row.

Show markup 5 lines 
<div class="l-cluster">
  <span class="c-badge">Design</span>
  <span class="c-badge">Research</span>
  <span class="c-badge">Accessibility</span>
</div>

validate: 0 issues

Doesn't fit

Don't space items with margins.

<div class="l-cluster">
  <button type="button" class="c-button" style="margin-right: 8px">Back</button>
  <button type="button" class="c-button c-button--primary">Next</button>
</div>

validate

  • warning Components must not set their own margin. Wrap them in a layout primitive (l-stack, l-cluster…) instead. [golden-rule]
